name: Long Sơn Pagoda
kicker: The seated white Buddha above the pagoda
summary: White Buddha on a city hill: climb to the seated figure in daylight for the statue over Nha Trang. Long Sơn is at 22 đường 23 tháng 10 and opens 07:00–17:30. The figure is 24 m, or 78 feet, from the ground, and the statue itself is 14 m.
getThere: 22 đường 23 tháng 10, at the foot of núi Trại Thủy.
heroCaption: The seated white Buddha on the lotus pedestal
body: Long Sơn is also the White Buddha Pagoda and Đăng Long tự. The address is 22 đường 23 tháng 10, at the foot of núi Trại Thủy. The ward is Phương Sơn, and also Tây Nha Trang. Hours are 07:00–17:30. Climb from the pagoda to the seated white figure on the hill.
The figure is 24 m, or 78 feet, from the ground, and 21 m from the base, with a lotus pedestal 10 m wide and the statue itself 14 m. Go in daylight so the white figure reads against the sky.

figures.caption: The face and the lotus, in a second photograph of the same seated figure
figures.alt: Close view of the white seated Buddha at Long Sơn

gettingThere: The pagoda is at 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Ride inland from the beach or from the station in the centre.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Ride inland to đường 23 tháng 10, then walk up to the seated figure.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station is in the centre. The pagoda is on đường 23 tháng 10.

admissionNote: The climb is to the seated figure.
